author: Tpak
body:
Ok. This, in my opinion, should not exist. First, you are donating money to help the Avicus. That is a good accomplishment becuase your are donating/purchasing something that Avicus will take hold of, and put it towards there server. But, I think that we sohuld get rid of temporary ranks because, it is just not right. You are giving money to a server, via purchasing a rank e.g. Gold. In 3 months however, you will be stripped of that rank. I think that is comeplety and utterly unacceptable. All ranks should be permanent. It is why you are purchasing it. To have it forever. I do agree that we should have Gold, Emerald & Diamond. I am just stating that they all should be permanent, not temporary. That is all I have to say, if you disagree, don't be scared to reply with a nice comment (no hate pls xD)

Kindest Regards
-Nooby_Billlz
